name: get_devices
description: List devices and their enabled, source-backed, and live-verified capabilities.

name: get_status
description: Read fresh battery, robot task, error, map, dock, progress, and position state.

name: get_map
description: Read sensitive home layout data. Codex must ask before image or geometry access.

name: get_cleaning_settings
description: Read global or room cleaning modes and the valid choices reported by the device.

name: get_dock_status
description: Read dock operation, errors, supported actions, and current dock settings.

name: get_automations
description: List native Roborock schedules and routines with opaque identifiers.

name: get_cleaning_history
description: Read aggregate cleaning statistics and a bounded page of cleaning history.

name: get_maintenance
description: Read consumable work times, remaining estimates, and resettable opaque keys.

name: get_obstacles
description: Read obstacle metadata and optionally sensitive onboard photos. Codex must ask first.

name: get_device_settings
description: Read DND, LED, child lock, sound, camera, and supported AI settings.

name: start_cleaning
description: Start one bounded full, room, zone, or spot cleaning task after Codex approval.

name: control_cleaning
description: Pause, resume, stop, or dock the current cleaning task.

name: run_routine
description: Execute exactly one routine selected from get_automations.

name: set_cleaning_settings
description: Set supported cleaning modes globally or for explicit rooms, then read back state.

name: dock_action
description: Run one capability-gated physical dock action.

name: set_dock_settings
description: Set supported dock options and reject values not advertised by the device.

name: navigate
description: Navigate to one fresh-map target or control a supported patrol mode.

name: remote_control
description: Perform a dead-man bounded RC sequence. Codex must ask and a human must supervise.

name: manage_map
description: Quick-map, resume, switch, or rename; deletion, backup, and recovery are not exposed.

name: edit_rooms
description: Preview by default; explicitly apply one reviewed split/merge. Rename needs the official app.

name: edit_map_boundaries
description: Add, replace, or remove one capability-gated map boundary on a current map revision.

name: manage_schedule
description: Create, update, delete, enable, or disable one native Roborock schedule.

name: reset_consumable
description: Irreversibly reset one reported consumable counter; intentionally exempt from a97 live testing.

name: set_device_settings
description: Set supported DND, LED, lock, sound, camera, and AI options, then reconcile state.

name: telepresence
description: Control a loopback-only camera/voice session. Codex must ask; no recording is supported.
